maddeler.e:
نشترف (form VIII)
# نَشْتَرِفُ (naštarifu) /naʃ.ta.ri.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِشْتَرَفَ (ištarafa)
# نُشْتَرَفُ (nuštarafu) /nuʃ.ta.ra.fu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِشْتَرَفَ (ištarafa)
# نَشْتَرِفَ (naštarifa) /naʃ.ta.ri.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِشْتَرَفَ (ištarafa)
# نُشْتَرَفَ (nuštarafa) /nuʃ.ta.ra.fa/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
